verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Scheduled Rollouts, which let a Feature Gate roll out gradually over time on a schedule. That covers time-based releases, but the evidence only describes gradual percentage rollouts, not arbitrary flag changes set for a specific future time. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling of arbitrary flag or config changes at a chosen date and time, details on how schedules are configured (UI, Console API or CLI), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
